items.quote: may Abimelek be your joy, and may you be his, too!
items.contrast: The honorable-action condition leads to mutual joy; the failure-to-act-honorably condition leads to each side consuming the other by fire.
items.reason: The proposed alternative is plausible because it appears immediately afterward, but it belongs to the opposite condition, “if you have not.” Under “If you have,” the speaker clearly wishes that Abimelek and the people would be one another’s joy.
